candidates.title: MipKV: A Sparsify-Then-Recover Paradigm for Accelerating Large Vision-Language Model Pre-Filling
candidates.venue: 2026 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition- FINDINGS Track (CVPRF)
candidates.abstract: Recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) support dynamic-resolution inference, yet high-resolution inputs inevitably produce a massive number of visual tokens, leading to prohibitive time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency. Existing pre-filling acceleration methods for LVLMs typically follow a token-pruning paradigm, which shortens the sequence length but is incompatible with efficient attention operators and struggles to balance acceleration and model performance. In this work, we introduce MipKV, a sparsify-then-recover framework for accelerating LVLM pre-filling without sacrificing performance. MipKV downsamples visual tokens into multiple thumbnails with varied offsets, prunes all crossthumbnail attentions for aggressive sparsification, and selectively recomputes tokens with large key-value deviation to recover critical information. On Qwen2-VL, MipKV achieves 97.5% of the original performance using only 16.25% of the self-attention FLOPs, achieving 7.45x faster attention operation and outperforming the existing token-pruning-based methods.
candidates.reason: 一次要旨で視覚トークンを多重解像度へ間引いてから復元するLVLMプリフィル高速化MipKVが確認でき、LLM推論システムの計算量・メモリ・遅延の削減へ直接つながる具体的な機構を持つためacceptとした。
